Deck Name: The Kingdom Underground

Crypt 12

Nosferatu

2x Murat 7 POT OBF ser / Prince of Istambul
1x Calebros, the Martyr 5 ANI pot obf / Prince of New York

Library 71

Master 15 (13 + 2)

4x Zillah' s Valley
2x Minion Tap
2x Vessel - Trifle
1x Information Highway
1x Legendary Vampire
1x The Labyrinth
1x Pentex Subversion
1x Temptation of Greater Power
1x Elysium: the Palace of Versailles
1x Direct Intervention

Equipment 4

1x Bowl of Convergence
1x AK-47
1x Assault Rifle
1x .44 Magnum
1x Ivory Bow
1x Heart of Nizchetus

Political Action 20

7x Parity Shift
6x Kine Resources Contested
2x Banishment
2x Alastor
1x Ancilla Empowerment
1x Anarchist Uprising
1x Meddling of Semsith

Action Modifier 19

5x Freak Drive
4x Forgotten Labyrinth
4x Elder Impersonation
4x Lost In crowds
2x Into Thin Air

Combo (Mod/Combat) 4

4x Swallowed by the Night

Reaction 7

7x The Second Tradition: Domain

I played this deck violating all my playing strict principles (no
deflections, and stelathy deck) though it worked wonders giving me 3
table wins and qualifiying first before the finals. In the finals I
was bled since very early stage of the game, before I had my first
vampire out (Shelon) my predator, ventru/!ventrue dominate mid/low-cap
deck, bled me for six and continued deflecting and bleeding until I
had my alastor out and torporised one of his 2 vampires, the other one
being sent to torpor by my prey, assamite AK-47 multi rush, after
trying to survive in a bleed table (Nosferatu vote --> assamite multi
rush --> Kyasid bleed stealth --> malk/!malk bleed stelath --Z
ventrue/!ventrue mid/low-cap bleed) I managed to get my VP in a
desperate KRC on my prey when he already had 2 VP'S and 2 pool left,
but me being at one, next turn I would have had my last vampire sent
to torpor empty (and there where no other players left alive on
table). So that was table for him, 1 VP for the kyasid and 1 for me.

Greetings,

Iñaki.-
